Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P./opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

2. This anticipatory bail application has been filed by the applicant to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case No.4350 of 2008 arising out of Case Crime No.713 of 2007, under Sections 406,
409, 419, 420, 467, 468 IPC, registered at Police Station- Gopiganj, District- Bhadohi, during the pendency of the trial.
3. After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has not pressed the relief as sought by means of this application on merit and prayed for issuance of appropriate direction to the concerned Courts below to decide the bail application of the applicant expeditiously..

6. 7.
